# MORPH

> MORPH is an open-source adaptive UI runtime. Apps define capabilities (Zod-typed components),
> deterministic workspace templates, a workspace tree and policies. MORPH turns a user's intent into
> small typed decisions (choice / score / noul) answered by a provider (Jev, rules or replay), picks
> a workspace with beam search, gates it on confidence and risk, checks policy in code, and renders
> validated UI state. Models never write UI code, markup or numbers.

Key rules: numbers and dates are computed by a facts engine, never by a model. Providers only see
lens output, never raw rows. Keys stay on the server; browsers use `RemoteProvider`. Narrative
claims must cite fact IDs and are verified in code before display.

## Docs
- [README](https://github.com/yahyeameer/MORPH/blob/main/README.md): overview, quickstart, API sketch
- [SPEC](https://github.com/yahyeameer/MORPH/blob/main/SPEC.md): full specification and invariants
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/yahyeameer/MORPH/blob/main/AGENTS.md): rules for coding agents
- [Architecture decisions](https://github.com/yahyeameer/MORPH/tree/main/docs/decisions)
- [Deploying the demo](https://github.com/yahyeameer/MORPH/blob/main/docs/deploy.md)

## Packages
- `morph-core`: `createMorph`, `CapabilityRegistry`, `RulesProvider`, `ReplayProvider`,
  `CompositeProvider`, `RemoteProvider`, `runGate`, `beamSearch`, `compose`, `diff`, `verifyClaims`,
  `RingBufferSink`, `summarize`. Subpaths: `morph-core/providers/jev` (server only, `JevProvider`)
  and `morph-core/node` (server only, file fixture store).
- `morph-react`: `MorphProvider`, `MorphIntentBar`, `MorphAlternates`, `MorphWorkspace`,
  `MorphInspector`, `MorphWhyThis`, `useMorph`.

## Code map
- [packages/core/src](https://github.com/yahyeameer/MORPH/tree/main/packages/core/src): runtime
- [packages/react/src](https://github.com/yahyeameer/MORPH/tree/main/packages/react/src): React bindings and inspector
- [apps/demo](https://github.com/yahyeameer/MORPH/tree/main/apps/demo): Next.js Talk-to-UI demo, API routes, shadcn registry
- [fixtures/golden](https://github.com/yahyeameer/MORPH/tree/main/fixtures/golden): golden scenarios G01–G13
